notes.title: The VVIP Update is Here
notes.content:

Let’s just hope the spirits stay on their plane of existence…[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Enjoy Endless Mode in Style. [/b]Swap out Samar’s outfits and even other characters to play as your faves. notes.title: Bug Fixes & Week 1 Recap!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Swappers![/h1]

It’s been officially one week since you’ve all started swapping ~ we hope you’re having an incredible time!

We’ve all been chatting and lurking in streams, watching videos, and taking notes on all of your feedback and reactions to the game, and wanted to share what we’ve been working on in regards to bug fixes and polish since launch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/dfc84fde8393782747830240339b2569384b90d8.png[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter Backers: Let us know if you didn’t get your key! [/h2]

As a general reminder, you should have your Steam keys by now! If you haven’t seen your key yet, please make sure to: 
[olist]
[*] [b]Remember if you participated in the Beta[/b] ~ if so, you already have your key! Just right click on the game in your library, go to Properties > Betas > Select “none” on the dropdown menu. The game should update to the full release version. 
[*] [b]Check your spam folder[/b] -- it may have ended up there - to help with the search, please note all the keys were send on Feb 3rd! And, if you still can't find it...
[*] [b]Email contact@softnotweak.com[/b] -- It’ll help if you can include the email you used when backing the Kickstarter and/or your Backer number! 
[/olist]
[h2]Thank you for helping us get to 80+ Steam Reviews![/h2]

WAHOO! Our first milestone goal was around 50 by the first week, and we’re already almost to 100?! Y’all are the best! 

If you've been playing and haven't yet left a review, please consider doing so!

As a reminder, leaving Steam Reviews for indie games is one of the best ways to help out post-launch if you enjoyed what you played! It can help us get more visibility (algorithmically but also for future Steam-related opportunities) and reviews help us when talking with other potential partners (like publishers, funds, or even merch folks!) 🥳

[h2]Bug Fixes & Updates[/h2]

These issues shouldn’t [i]bug [/i] you anymore! Here’s the list of all the fixes and polish we’ve just pushed to the game. We're not done yet, though, so please continue to share any bugs and feedback via our [url=https://bit.ly/SpiSwaBugReport]bug report form[/url] and Discord!

Without further ado, today's fixes include: 

[list]
[*] Run in Background enabled, default screen mode set to Fullscreen Window (i.e. Borderless Window)
[*] Minor difficulty decrease to Spicy and Sheesh 
[*] Edited for misspellings in events and character descriptions 
[*] Edited for colored text readability 
[*] Skip button is now hold-to-use, starts slower, accelerates, and is on E/Right Bumper
[*] Fixed Timekeeper not working properly in Endless mode 
[*] Added a pop-up before the credits roll to make it clearer that the game continues afterwards 
[*] Fixed achievements being delayed 
[*] "Gimme Variety" achievement is fixed, and should unlock retroactively
[*] Fixed typo in credits and included missing Witch on High tier
[*] Limited Refresh Rates available in Resolution Settings to only the current monitors refresh rate
[*] Remove refresh rate display on Resolution Settings (we now just take whatever the current monitor is)
[*] Fixed Samar, Dio, Cleo, and Theo individually being counted as part of the total affection count leading to improper progress display.
[*] Fixed fast as f*ck display check not functioning
[/list]

[b]Again, find a bug? Let us know![/b]
The best place to let us know? [url=https://bit.ly/SpiSwaBugReport]This bug report form[/url]! 

[h2]REMINDER: Get your own Froggo 🐸 [/h2]

The Makeship campaign is LIVE and only has 14 days left! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/8ee2480f98355dee7ad0a3e281bc68d631c42297.png[/img]

Check out the page [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/froggo]here[/url] and you can pre-order a Froggo of your very own (cheeks and all!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/c6cc279634e58b8e85fb54e271ac0b71b8502735.jpg[/img]

The campaign will only fund and ship if we make it to the goal of 200 Froggos pre-ordered, and we're already just over 20% funded, so be sure to get that in ahead of the deadline to help ensure it becomes a reality!

Again, we've been SO over the moon with how the reception has been. From cosplay, fanart, snippets of fanfic, and even the first ever Spirit Swap tournament (!!!), you've made this a truly special experience. 

Can't wait to share more about the upcoming update 🤩 But that'll be for next time! Thanks, and stay tuned ~ until then, keep swapping!

notes.title: Under 30 Days to Launch 👀✨
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Swappers![/h1]


Happy New Year! The holiday decor is stored, snacks eaten, and we are under 30 days (!!!) until we launch Spirit Swap. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/85fdbc25ccba1115cd74f4d5d3f11bfbf6099be0.png[/img]

Ahead of the launch, we wanted to share our plans for the game: what you can expect upon release and beyond! It’s -- hopefully -- also our chance to share a little bit more behind-the-scenes and what we’ve learned as we’ve done this first game together as a team for those interested in a little of what it takes to make a game in 2025.

[h2]Our major post-launch update will include Fashion 🌸[/h2]

With this update, you’ll be able to dress up Samar in a selection of outfits to swap in style!

While we wish we could have included Fashion in the game's 1.0 launch, the reality is that making a game is expensive—even more so because one of our tenants as a co-op is to pay all of our contractors living wages, thus expanding our costs a bit more. Adding this feature in post-launch content allows us to get that final bit of funds to help pay our contractors and get the feature to you in a quality state. 

We already have some of the outfit concepts from our Backers done -- while we won’t show you what we ARE using, here’s an example of two that didn’t quite make the cut…and one that did! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ec1de0db805c1635d763bd22e58b7999de994416.png[/img]

Our plan is to get this post-launch update out in 2025, and once we have a more solid date, you bet we’ll be shouting it from the rooftops! 

[h2]We had to say goodBHY to BHYG mode [/h2]

One of the realities of game development is scope. It’s one of the tried and true tenets that if you’re making a game, you should scope down…and then scope down again. While we initially thought our scope could account for a BHYG Mode (an 8-player versus frenzy), once we got into development and discussion over it these last few months, it ended up not panning out in terms of what we could finish -- and polish -- to the quality that we hoped to achieve. 

Now, will BHYG Mode someday make its way back into the world of Spirit Swap? We won’t lie: we’d love to try our hand at it again in the future, perhaps if the funding, time, and stars align. But, at the moment, we’re saying goodBHY to this game mode, and plan on focusing more on making the features we DO have in the game as solid as possible!

[h2]Continuing to Finesse[/h2]

Some of the things we have been spending our time finessing include ensuring we have a variety of features to help folks play how they want to. So, we thought we’d spend a little time checking out the Settings tab!

One of the first settings we have to help folks out is the ability to manipulate saturation -- to help ease eye strain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ca509d3271e80e5f610bb8601091545d26b3234e.gif[/img]

We’ve also included text animation! The game’s text waves, shakes, and even changes color to help ensure that visually -- not just auditorily -- you can sense how the tone of the conversation is going. 

The story log is also implemented if you need to take a look back at what was said in the latest scene:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7189e3841a06cc3555785cd34da2098896b7144e.png[/img]

We’ve even included a different style of spirit (harkening back to the OG Panel de Pon days) for folks who prefer that visual style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ef23be622d3e087dd108d0fb5eebe46cecbffbc7.gif[/img]

Finally, we’ve also added the “Skip this Round” button to the pause screen. We know sometimes you just wanna get to the story, or perhaps you’re just not feeling it that round. You can always skip and move on to the next round (or just skip them all and not do the match entirely). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/6c38003f7f4af0e1df0d98dcaf6eaa6f1518ae69.png[/img]

These are just a few of the additions we’ve included, and we’re continuing to polish polish polish! Our main priority right now is going through and playing the game as much as possible, trying to catch everything we can ahead of Feb 3rd. 


[h2]Say hello to an IRL Froggo [/h2]

We do have some exciting news on the Froggo front! Over the past few months, we’ve been working with the Makeship crew to design a Froggo plush so you can have a FamiliarZ of your very own to chill with. Check out the page here (and be sure to visit it on Feb 3rd if you’d like to pick a Froggo for yourself)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/2f97210a4e7270e90480f250609479ae71ed85f8.jpg[/img]

For those unfamiliar with Makeship, it’s a crowdfunding campaign-based plushie company. During a campaign, if we reach our goal of pre-orders for the plushie, then it becomes a reality! They will take care of all the manufacturing, shipping, and fulfillment. We’ve already got an adorable design, and can’t wait to share the unredacted image with you all soon. 

That’s it for this month’s update! We’re working hard and can’t believe the day is almost here! Feb 3, here we gooooo~ 

<3 The Spirit Swap team

[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers,[/h1]

Two weeks have passed in the blink of an eye, and it’s time for our first update since the Backer Beta has gone live! Today will be a quicker update, showing off a succession of screenshots (ooo!) and gifs (aah!) of the polish and fixes we’ve done based on the feedback we’ve received. 

[h2]Deepen Your Relationships: B Supports are IN![/h2]

In the first version of the Beta, we only included the initial round of main narrative events -- what we’ve been calling internally the “C Supports”. These events with each character helped you meet them and get to know them. A little sampling. A taste test, if you will. Now? You can deepen those relationships further because we’ve added each character's second tier of main events. Their B Supports! Here are screenshots of a few B support moments now implemented into the game ~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fc394e7cd0a2a3ae10aedbec837017020231bd8c.png[/img]

And more!

They’re still coming along! These two elements are still planned, but their complexity means they’ll likely be included in an update not too long after the main launch of the game.

[h2]A new trailer is in the works[/h2]

What’s that? A fresh trailer? YUP! We are in the process of getting ready to announce the release date, which means storyboarding and starting to prep the launch trailer. For funsies, here’s a sneak peek at a favorite early WIP storyboard frame…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fc28005c69c6b3839a479385e4e39388d374182d.png[/img]

[h2]So, when is the full game coming out? [/h2]

When deciding when to release the game, we’re not only take into account when the game is done -- we’re also tracking other game releases and event opportunities that can help us reach the most folks with the news. 

Because of a few opportunities we’re aiming for (and for a bit of a full circle moment for ourselves), we’ve decided to release in early 2025. We’re tossing around a couple of specific dates, and depending on what additional support we can garner, that may impact which one we go with. (hee hee hee ho ho ho, marketing witchcraft and secrets) 

As soon as we can share an official date, we will let you know! But for now, we sincerely hope that you’ve enjoyed this update. We’ll be aiming to post monthly again now that we’re in the midst of the Backer Beta. 

Have fun in Demashq!  

💜 The Spirit Swap team

notes.title: Time-for-an-Update Thursday!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Spirit Swappers,[/h2]

We have emerged! Crisp leaves, rainy days, and cool weather (finally) is also bringing in a wave of updates and news. Ready? Ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/871aaa7d1f09b67493759d3c62a8e7e43dedae07.png[/img]

[h2]Spirit Swap is coming in 2024 ✨[/h2]

2023 has been a year of incredible progress for our team. We’ve made substantial headway on the game, and are incredibly proud of how far it’s come along. I mean, just look at this early work compared to now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ce1d71d5943077826273ce1210e97caaaa932fe5.png[/img]

Attending our first-ever physical event EVER this year (more on PAX West below) meant it was the first time we got to experience the joy of watching people play Spirit Swap in-person. It was immensely inspiring to our whole team, and a huge validation of the work we’ve put in thus far. 

Our number one priority has been about creating the best game we can - inspired by the people and communities we love - while always considering the well-being of our team. While we’ve made strides in the progress of the game and towards a full launch, these spirits need a little more time before they can be swapped by the general public, and we don’t believe in crunching to do so. 

[b]As a result, we’d like to share that we've decided to push Spirit Swap’s launch to 2024. [/b]

We truly appreciate the patience and kindness you’ve all shown throughout this whole process thus far, and we can’t wait for y’all to be able to fully dive into the game once it’s ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/3aa8ea42839a1d734a236934671707dfd44d4c25.png[/img]

[h2]PAX West Recap 🥳[/h2]

Because PAX West takes place in Seattle, we knew we wanted to be sure and attend! This year, we had the pleasure of being a part of the PAX Rising booth, a celebration of indie games (particularly those who don’t have a publisher/are self-publishing).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/277c8a84c14587ae653cfbba9d1cdae82d4864d9.png[/img]

In addition to a rare instance where the entire team was in one place (YAY!) we also got to watch and learn as visitors played two different available demos for Spirit Swap. The narrative demo…and local Versus! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/255835305061d336aca112046935240542c5c0a1.png[/img]

In addition to the many kind words from folks who came by, we came away from the event with some memorable press coverage. From notable outlets like [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/14-must-see-games-from-pax-west-2023]IGN[/url] - who classified us as one of the top games to see at PAX West - and [url=https://gaymingmag.com/2023/09/spirit-swap-is-for-our-queer-extended-family/]Gayming Magazine[/url], to getting highlighted by local journalists, like in [url=https://www.geekwire.com/2023/pacific-drive-and-spirit-swap-are-highlights-from-the-pacific-nws-game-developer-scene-at-pax/]GeekWire[/url]. The word on the street is that Spirit Swap is full of style and heart, and we’re SO happy to hear it (and hope to keep delivering!) 

[h2]More Narrative Work 📝[/h2]

Another picture of a word doc? You got it! The major element we have left is narrative and filling the game with delicious, delectable ~content~. The “Golden Path” (the narrative backbone) of the game is done, so all of the  work right now is making sure we have the events and chat logs to really make these characters come to life. 

Actually, wait. Instead of a word doc…. How about the first glimpse at one of the CGs you could potentially unlock as you play? 👀 PRETTYYYYYY

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/8aed6532a982950010d06617fb4587567047356c.png[/img]

[h2]We Heard Your Feedback! ✅[/h2]

One of the major recurring pieces of feedback we’ve gotten through our various demo forms is the request to have more character expressions to fully convey the emotions Samar and their friends are going through. We totally agreed! Here are a few of the expressions Sam’s been working on. Our favorite detail?  The flowers that tie in with her emotional state! AHHHH!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/8197115d504cc15512dcf335c6d926f830edd30f.png[/img]

See you next month, 

The home stretch is always the longest, at least, it can feel that way, but we’re happy to be sharing this journey with you all. Thanks again!

Until next time, find us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/softnotweak]Twitter[/url], our [url=https://discord.gg/pSYhWbq2J8]Discord[/url], or here in the comments if you have any questions. Stay hydrated and safe!


[h3]Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team[/h3]

notes.title: Merry Monday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fdf2489e23ab0f7944e5a1b4e5bb71ec78bbed83.png[/img]

[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers![/h1]

We have emerged! It’s now spring, and like the beautiful butterfly, we

Wait. 

While yes, we are emerging like beautiful butterflies with lots of cool things to share, we also wanted to say that it’s been a while because we’ve been heads down developing Spirit Swap in addition to balancing our day jobs and Life(™). 

We’re sorry for the quiet period, but happy to say that we’ve gotten to a point in the game’s progress where we’re able to hop back into sharing mode. We’ve got a lot, so let’s get started!

[h2]Polish Till It Shines! 👀[/h2]

Updated environments? IN!
World map? DONE. 
Amazing emotes? CHECK. 
Gradients for days? YES.

In addition to working on core features, a good chunk of time has been on polishing and making sure the game looks colorful, joyful, and full of that *special sauce*. 

We could just sit here and describe it all to you, but I remember learning in 5th grade about ‘showing, not telling’ so why not show you a few gifs to illustrate what we mean? 

Just as a reminder, check out our world map before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5af611f6928f7b73e35d041ed2f437631e6c0028.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/c2644547fb02d50b70bf9cdef9bb9863428486e1.png[/img]

And here it is NOW: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a77b379177ee74829f0a2f9de655bd98e56f1a34.gif[/img]

We LOVE how it’s turned out, and would love to know: where would you want to head to first? 
All the environments and locations have also been updated and fully implemented, like Leon’s Tattoo Parlor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/999ba99f4e28a7563653363a5925b3630e4ca86d.gif[/img]

And here’s the updated take on Ishk’s Beach!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/e63ed741cf01c6c59293361562566b90204908b7.gif[/img]

Now that the world is all there, what we’ll be focusing on is getting all of the narrative in, and testing, testing, testing.

[h2]Once Upon a Time … [/h2]

Speaking of narrative! Alex has been finessing the story of Spirit Swap, and while we can’t tell you TOO much about the specifics (this is a spoiler-free zone!) we CAN share this: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d444c57e16fe607af49e14c56475fd14a46df02a.png[/img]

Okay, jokes aside, we’ve been really pleased with how each of our characters have come to life -- in addition to getting the story into the game to playtest it, finalizing VO is also up next, and we can’t wait for that!

[h2]Versus Hype[/h2]

In addition to working on story mode, Versus has been getting lots of UI/UX love so you can swap your hearts out (either with a friend or with a CPU!) 

Check out this character select screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/153f18b605bcc4a0253da580814eff81cb9b8b8f.gif[/img]

And as you pick your characters, you’ll be able to customize how chill (or not!) you’d like your board to be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/20c3a3e8ab530bc63f195168ad3e23e5d7a81fea.gif[/img]

[h2]Out on the Town[/h2]

Rejon and Jenny attended GDC! 

Rejon gave an INCREDIBLE (actually got people teary) talk about Spirit Swap titled “Inclusive Nostalgia” as part of a wider panel titled “Game Design for Inclusive Representation”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/f13a3021e786aba8d933f3312ca8503d270f944e.png[/img]

Jenny - along with the rest of the Wholesome Games team - talked about why wholesome games matter: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/73210df3bede13490dc5a0cf823b3821764d084e.png[/img]

The SpiSwa team also got to hang out with Adanna and Jenna (members of the Spirit Swap narrative team) for the first time ever in-person, enjoying some delicious ramen together! ;-; <3

[h2]See you next month[/h2]

WHEW! We’re excited to really ramp up sharing news with you all now that spring has sprung. Thanks for all your patience, and we’ll be back with more dev updates at the end of May!

Until then, find us on Twitter, our Discord, or here in the comments if you have any questions. Stay hydrated and safe!


Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: Flashy Friday!
notes.content:
[h1]Leaves are falling and the spirits need swapping…[/h1]

It’s been an eventful time for the Soft Not Weak team! We’ve been busy at work polishing up some LOVELY snippets to show off, and we boy oh boy are we excited to show them off! In addition to that, we have an UPDATED DEMO for you all to try! Ready? Set? GOOOOOOOO: 

[h2]Indieland 2022 and our UPDATED DEMO![/h2]

[b]First things first! We’re lucky and honored to be a part of [url=https://www.twitch.tv/TheCompletionist]Indieland 2022[/url]! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/acaa85d96706d73dd7061feb6797b6c36fba110a.jpg[/img]

Not only is this event an amazing fundraiser for a good cause, but Jirard and the team behind Indieland always curate a fantastic showcase filled with indie games to keep an eye on.

To celebrate, [b]we’ve decided to release an updated Endless mode demo,[/b] chock full of polish and juice we’ve been working on to help bring Samar’s forest to life! Below we’ll break down a lot of the details that you’ll see, but if you’re itching to get going, you can start playing the demo now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592170/Spirit_Swap_Lofi_Beats_to_Match3_To/

A couple of additional notes about the demo:
[list]
[*] For MAC users: Some Mac users might encounter controller issues due to Mac driver compatability. If that occurs, please use the keyboard!
[*] For Keyboard: You can use WASD or ARROW keys to navigate as well the inputs described in game! 
[/list]

Otherwise, read on to learn about what we’ve been working on, and tune in to Twitch on Saturday at 7 PM PDT to watch as Jenny (our producer) chats with the team at Indieland about Spirit Swap! 

[h2]Polish Based on Your Feedback![/h2]

Okay, so first thing is we’ve been doing a lot of UI/UX polish (major shoutout to [url=https://twitter.com/Maximum_Crash]Réjon[/url] for all of the work designing this and to Morgan for hooking it all together). We really wanted to make sure that different elements of the game, different states of play, all of it will be communicated to you as clearly and quickly as possible. 

This began with the game board! Because your eyes will be focusing on the spirits, you need to be able to, at a glance and with your peripheral vision, be able to determine your health and general status. Here, we have our latest iteration of the board:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/0841640b91cfbde04ad5c5f22a2c29a31b274028.gif[/img]

You’ll be able to tell when it’s getting a little hot and you’ve gotta make some matches and quick, as well as see when everything’s a-okay and you have time to chill. 

Elements like the SpellMeter have been updated to also more clearly indicate as segments fill when you make matches: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1a96d89b08b597e0fcff4eda1cb440075c785907.gif[/img]

Even the spell bubble has some extra polish so you know when it’s time to cast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7e516058185b87531f0c3e80f184df523430e17f.gif[/img]

[h2]Press ESC to pet the Frog[/h2]

We’ve also been working on dynamic button prompts, which was another big feedback point during our previous survey and demo (thanks, y’all!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/47529454719e88967d41d914d5221aa9cd2b0046.gif[/img]

We now have the ability to make those buttons match whatever controller you’re using, and it’ll switch to match dynamically as well! Catch how this dialogue looks in action with a few snips from our revamped “How to Play” section of the Endless demo: 

[h2]Take a Breath in the Endless Forest[/h2]

You’re familiar with the Endless Forest, as it’s where our demo takes place… but you haven’t seen it quite like this! 

The original background is beautiful, but with just a little bit of parallaxing, and some time and energy, we’ve got it looking more in-depth in time for your eyes to enjoy -- huge thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/abellehayford]Abelle[/url] for adding that extra magic and style to the woods (and our other backgrounds).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/45ac0c0865b2f94660fa36f0a8f933168d76fafa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Vibe? Chill? SHEEESH?![/h2]

Here’s a more comprehensive look at the settings in our Endless mode. When you’re getting ready to swap forever, you’ll be able to adjust the speed level, difficulty, and spell loadouts before you play, to ensure it’s exactly the experience you want. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d195f21fb6240ac538ae7e034b92de5363fd5e91.gif[/img]

[h2]AND MORE![/h2]
There’s even more to enjoy, like [b]a brand-new song from the ever-talented [url=https://twitter.com/meltycanon]meltycanon[/url][/b], additional VN UI/UX updates to make our cast *pop* during narrative scenes, and (if you’d love to help us) a brand new survey you can fill out to let us know what you think of the polish after you play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/cc38af52174472ce2a0d8ecb58e91d52440e0439.gif[/img]

[h2]What do you think? [/h2]

Hopefully you enjoyed seeing everything we’ve been working on! We love sharing with you and are so excited to hear what you think about the polish we’ve added to the Endless mode demo. If you’ve got any questions or just wanna say hi, find us on Twitter (@softnotweak), our Discord, or here in the comments!


Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: Fancy (Graphics) Friday
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers![/h1]

WHAT A MONTH! June was the time for not-E3 festivities to get into full swing, oh, and a little something called Pride? You may have heard of it! ^_^ 

We were especially happy to be a part of the Wholesome Direct and Future of Play (which you can watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5IRgvwWLpbA]here [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vx3w3Ssv8ZM]here[/url], respectively). 

And, the DEMO. We released a limited time, narrative-focused demo to show off some of what we’ve been working on, and we were blown away by the feedback y’all gave us. (That’s why this update is a liiiittle later than normal, since we’ve been crunching numbers and going through every single bit of feedback!) 

Let’s dive into this month’s update, and I’ll tell you more: 

[h2]Demo Feedback[/h2]

Most of what we’ve been doing since the demo (after taking a little rest) has been going through all the feedback and adjusting our priorities based on that! 

We really appreciate everyone who took the time to answer our questions and help us get a better idea of what your expectations are, what we’re doing well, and what still needs work! 

So, without further ado, here’s a very [b]high level [/b]summary of what you & the rest of the community had to say!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/104c9ebd51f91c763385ca24740adf9f8d5167ae.png[/img]

You really love: the vibes! When we asked you to rank the different elements of the game thus far, the visual style FAR outranked every other element, with music as a close second!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/6452c3658fd7591bd1e58c5ac733f0aa73a578e1.png[/img]

In that same ranking (and throughout the verbal feedback provided in the form), it was clear that we could improve upon tutorialization and allowing for more time for players to get into the game and its mechanics! 

Whether folks ranked themselves as total newcomers to the genre or as seasoned pros, the pace of the tutorial was another element that we got lots of comments on, and will address!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/3033e53946153a929878c1809781f299f9542c0d.png[/img]

70% of players could correctly identify the square spell and its effect! For those who need a quick reminder: the square spell clears the top half of the board as well as converts garbage into spirits!

But, we also found only 56% of players would count themselves as very confident in using the spell in-game. So, we’ll be working on ways to help bring that confidence up with spells (and beyond!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/6d0cdba9bd241ac74850b92161b7be1d9d68284c.png[/img]

89% of players could correctly identify and explain the purpose of the Spellmeter! 

(Psst -- the Spellmeter will charge as you make matches, and will allow you to cast spells as the bars of the meter fill!)

Quick shoutout to the person who appreciated the effort I took with Paint. :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7dd3892381a8632d519af134354f869395a737ee.png[/img]

Despite tutorialization needing a little work, almost half of you rated the difficulty as a “3” on a scale of one to five, which is right smack dab in the middle! We were pretty pleased looking at the distribution of this curve, and happy to see that it skewed a little bit towards folks considering it “not as difficult” than “incredibly challenging”. 

Regardless, we WILL be finessing AI difficulty for everyone, in addition to working on other fixes to polish the level of challenge in each match. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/0715dc3c4ccfd131c9eccff7bfa1b7b9634d2fd9.png[/img]

Your favorite character was Samar, and Mo was a VERY close second! Leon probably received the most verbal love in the comments, though, and we were surprised at how many of you requested more FamiliarZ content! :) It’s duly noted!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a7403f13e412425c28429342152ab59db68acc5a.png[/img]

While we can’t type every comment that we received, you all had some kind words and specific elements that you enjoyed (and that really made our hearts happy)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5b0bf73e46e577ff3d33cb3488acadd8c5f83b68.png[/img]

Things like appreciating the little reminders in the loading screens (hydrate, please!), the 90’s references, and the fact that our characters are HOT and GAY (SO many of you put this in the feedback!) We really loved seeing what resonated with you the most!

There’s SO much more that we’ve drawn from after reading all of your feedback. Much more than can be captured here. So we’ll leave you this month with a big THANK YOU for taking the time to provide both the heartwarming words and thoughtful critiques and hopes for the game. 

The last thing we wanted to share is some feedback we hope happens in the future for ALL of us (you too!): more money and more naps. <3 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/45fa99775c061efc241dd46f65e6a3334e87ce94.png[/img]
[h1]
Stay cool ~ 
[/h1]
That’s it for this month! We’ll be back with more usual dev updates in July ~ until then, find us on Twitter, our Discord, or here in the comments if you have any questions. Stay hydrated and safe!


Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: June 2022: Demo Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]The demo is live! [/b][/h1]

We’re really looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the [b]narrative demo that we’ve shared for Spirit Swap [/b]-- and if you’ve played it, please remember to fill out the feedback form (found [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeRroFCrudpqtStjxK-vDSZqN_q0plfNsj6aGAjDyFf36Dzfw/viewform][b]here[/b][/url]). 

This demo is still a work-in-progress toward our final vision of Spirit Swap, and we wanted to illuminate a few details for you: some larger bugs and polish we’re aware of and still working on…and even ~secrets~ you can try out if you’re looking for a challenge!

[h2]UI/UX: Input [/h2]

We’re working on making sure the control schemes are consistently displayed in the demo: right now, they switch between keyboard and gamepad (which is good for keeping you on your toes, but not for clarity!)  

Here’s a quick overview of controls:

[b]Keyboard Controls:[/b]
 
WASD or Arrow Keys -- Move cursor
J / Space  -- Confirm (dialogue and swap) 
SHIFT / K / ALT -- cast spell 
ESC -- Pause


[b]Gamepad Controls: [/b]

D-pad -- Move cursor
A/B -- Confirm (dialogue and swap)
X/Y -- cast spell
LB/RB - Raise Board
Start -- Pause

[h2]Space: The Final Frontier[/h2]

If you hit space during the loading screen, you may progress the visual novel dialogue, so spam space (or A) at your own risk! 

[h2]Audio Issues? Just Restart![/h2]

While we think we may have squashed this bug, we’d love to give a heads up in case you happen to experience this! If you don’t hear any audio in the title screen (specifically the background music), try quitting out of the demo and re-opening. That should do the trick!


[h2]Secret Spells[/h2]

If you’ve played the demo, you’ve seen the Square spell...but did your eagle eyes notice two other spell shapes to the right and left of the trusty SQUARE spell during the tutorial? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5b8283e77d11c3b20f21965df0a73a0d321836c2.png[/img]

If you’re looking for a special challenge, you can try out these two secret spells: Diamond and X!

They’re implemented in the demo, and technically playable, but we didn’t want to (officially) tutorialize and test them quite yet…but, who’re we to stop you if you wanted to give ‘em a try? 

If you’re wanting to step up your swapping game, the shapes you need to make to cast DIAMOND and X are listed below (the red shapes indicate the same color spirits that must be placed):

DIAMOND
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/77a83ec9ce31ddaec99e81608de64b90daa3a6aa.png[/img]

X
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/e44db1f01c8a7ed112a31cf9c05fbcc658e50177.png[/img]

Like the SQUARE spell, both cost one bar on the Spellmeter to cast! 
Enjoy, and let us know if you happen to cast one (or both!) successfully!

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

If you want to chat with us, you can always hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/pSYhWbq2J8]Discord[/url], find us on [url=https://twitter.com/softnotweak]Twitter[/url], or send us an email at contact@softnotweak.com!

[h1][b]Hi Spirit Swappers![/b][/h1]

We wanted to share an important update on Spirit Swap’s development before diving into what we’ve been working on this past month: 

Your support and kindness throughout this whole process has been incredible. From an idea created by friends, to a successful Kickstarter: you have been with us and propelled this project further than we imagined! 

Like so many teams, we have also faced challenges this year -- some that we anticipated, and some we weren’t quite able to. To ensure we take into account the well-being of our team and the desire to create the best possible game that we can for you, [b]we have decided to shift our release to 2023[/b]. We truly appreciate your patience!

None of this would be possible without you, our amazing community, and we want to make sure you still have some FUN to tide you over. So, keep your eyes out for an exciting fresh demo experience coming in the near future. You’ll be able to visit Demashq and check out (first hand) what we’ve been up to! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/58382c7d77400911efa6ef0157565e48e5884778.png[/img]

[h2][b]Illustration Station[/b][/h2]

As we’ve been continuing our work on the hub area of the game, Samar’s Room, we’ve added yet another illustration to the mix! 

For a bit of a reminder and context: Samar’s Room is the central area of the game. You’ll come here when the day is done to relax.…and you’ll start here each morning, ready for a day of swapping, spells, and …sfriends! 

Our goal for the hub is for it to feel as diegetic and immersive as possible. To put it simply, this means as you move around, you’ll really feel like you’re in the room with Samar, seeing how they exist in the space, feeling a bit like you’re hanging out with them! 

So, for the option to “Head Out” we wanted to make sure to convey Samar leaving the room, but taking a couple of elements in mind. When we initially brainstormed the “Heading out” artwork showing Samar walking out of their front door. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a24c225d33adbc93e6badf6100492b02e79f1050.png[/img]

But there was a problem! We realized that since we will be providing the option for players to customize their outfits, if the illustration was different than the outfit equipped, that would ruin immersion! So, back to the drawing board….which then landed on the concept of a close-up while opening the front door. 

As [url=https://www.twitter.com/midniights__]midniights__ [/url] was sketching, we also wanted to make sure that when heading out, you were feeling like you were going to head out to Demashq,  not out of the game completely. 

Thus, the SWAPSWAPSWAP key chain and trinket illustration came to be! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/24a39c09d88ba8b8caf4b6e96f0647b5280ef26e.png[/img]

You’ll have to try the demo once it launches to see how the final version of the illustration turned out -- we think you’ll really like it!

(Also, who else wants this keychain?! WE DO!) 

[h2][b]She’s too smart![/b][/h2]

Here’s a silly moment we just had to share! 

[url=https://www.twitter.com/justmorgantime]Morgan[/url] has been working on the AI for Spirit Swap -- this AI is who you’ll be taking on anytime you go up against the computer during the game. While initially, Morgan’s robot daughter wasn’t the best at playing Spirit Swap… she has finally become too smart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/2799b6f06dfc638a8905080dbf901db67ce92121.gif[/img]

Don’t fret! We’ll have her paired down for the demo! Pro-players who’re itching to test your skills: you’ll be able to customize the difficulty in the final version of the game! In the meantime? Don’t forget the Oh geez, oh f*ck mode for anyone who wants a challenge in a big way!

notes.content:
[h2]Hi Swappers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1976ef04027d61b0db694fe47f226bf0ae4a2382.png[/img]

Get those headphones on -- today’s update is one that you’ll want to listen to. For this month, we’ve got an audio-themed post and inside look at what we’ve been working on in the realm of Spirit Swap's music!

[h2]Ready to visit the café?[/h2]

We’ve shared a lot of the visuals surrounding the game, but Spirit Swap is so highly inspired by music (specifically those good lo-fi beats), we wanted to be sure to highlight a bit of what’s been going on with the incredible meltycanon and Réjon!

Inspiration boards are created for each track and since we’re working on character and location-centric songs, that’s what each board is made of. These boards are to help melty hone in on the specific vibes and sounds to fully capture each character’s personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/724445d010572461cff56ac025873797360ea18b.png[/img]

Ready to hear the final result? [url=https://soundcloud.com/softnotweak/letter-to-lulu-april-2022-sample/s-uP4wAI6DVRE?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Click here[/url] to listen to a small sample of “Letter to Lulu'' meant to represent our favorite baker.
 
In addition to melty’s music, you’ll also hear soundscape elements in the game to fully capture the cozy bustle of the café. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/23759882a2f2a35cc29dd6147837da5fc8f16226.png[/img]

[i]Réjon: There’s a lot of little details that go into defining the sound design of a space, but for Lulu’s Café we start by imagining what someone sitting in the café would hear. I first started with consulting Alex about their home, and what this experience sounded like.

Alex: I really wanted to convey the particular vibe of sitting in a café by the beach like I used to in Lebanon. My mom particularly loves this one bougie café on the cliffside of “Raouché” in Beirut. You can sit on their patio outside and enjoy the sights and sounds of the sea while the café bustles behind you. Lulu’s café was meant to harken back to those times sipping on coffee while mom and grandma smoked hookah, so I described this to Réjon in detail and sent them photos.

Réjon: There are 3 anchors for designing the soundscape of the café, proximity to the ocean, the frequency of customers, and the cafe’s typical day by day vibe. Because good memories are typically warm, I lean into the ocean’s lower frequencies to help listeners soak it in and carry the silence with EQ balancing.[/i]

This was the basis of the back and forth between Alex and Réjon, recalling details and tweaking coffee pour sounds and clanking of cups and saucers until the vibe was hit exactly right. So right that Alex teared up listening to it because it made them homesick. Réjon really did not have to go that hard!

[url=https://soundcloud.com/softnotweak/lulus-cafe-ambiance-april-2022-sample/s-TmsDn3nma1V?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Click here to have a listen and enjoy the specific energy that these ambient sounds capture![/url]
 
[h2]See you next month ~[/h2]

Hope you and your ears are happier having gotten to sample some of the audio magic happening behind the scenes!

We’re prepping for a busy summer of events and festivities, so keep an eye out for some fun news soon! Let us know via Twitter, our Discord, TikTok, or here in the comments if you have any questions. Otherwise? See you next time!

Love,

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: Tasty Tuesday Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers ~ [/h1]

It has been A MONTH. Before we kick off with updates, we want to reaffirm our hope for this game and with you all, our community. We’re making a game that celebrates joy -- specifically brown, Black, and queer joy. In a time when it can be challenging to find news that is uplifting, we hope that our progress updates can at least bring you a small bit of cheer.

[h1](Vertical) Slice of Life![/h1]

Our focus this month was to finish the majority of our vertical slice, and by golly, I think we got there! 

What’s a vertical slice? A VERY quick description is that it’s a build of the game that includes a proof of concept of most major components in a game. So, all of the wireframing and foundational work that [url=https://www.twitter.com/justmorgantime]Morgi[/url] and [url=https://www.twitter.com/maximumcrash]Réjon[/url] have put together? They’re IN!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/dc4ab9f7c76cec43060950d276e6ca9fcd4e1156.gif[/img]

[i]Note: Art is WIP! Movement is WIP! BUT LOOK IT’S DEMASHQ ;-; [/i]

While there’s still some polish (and duck tape) that we’ve got to work out, we’ve got a great representative slice of what the game and it’s different components will look like. 

Part of the vertical slice was putting in narrative beats that segued directly into swapping, as well as getting the AI working! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1f0e5ab4505015c784a5cc09a14d12f4567be61d.gif[/img]

[i]Note: Lulu is ready to whip up recipes and swap out spirits! [/i]

Finally, we’ve got the ability to move through areas in the hub! Again, background art is still a placeholder, but this gives you a general idea of what we’re aiming for as you wander Samar’s Room and get ready to visit friends around town. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/b23f894f002b871bb84242cc27616cbed0dba0d9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Meaty Monday (August 2021 Update)
notes.content:
[h2]Kanon is flying into your heart![/h2]

Our animator, Khei (@kheillustration on Twitter!), has done some absolutely incredible work updating Kanon’s animation over the past weeks! We’re really excited by the details she’s been able to capture, between the flow of the wings, the soft glances around, the hands holding the apple…special shoutout to our sprite artist, Sam, for the wing upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/23862d92c4e6d0583425ba88ea58e3edf227abc0.gif[/img]

[h2]Lemme tell you a story…[/h2]

We’ve gotten a few questions on our Discord about how the narrative of Spirit Swap will work! So, this month, we wanted to dive into it some more.

Basically, the narrative creative process often looks like this interaction between one of our writers and the creative director:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/f27b3cbd07a0998b4edab2aeef3e208ad0b69d3d.png[/img]

Haha… just kidding… unless……. ahem

[i]But back to the game side of narrative![/i]

Let’s start with a simple overview of how story mode works (and you get to peek at our messy inVision board…)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1577ba71a211f4f703ee8cefffe5eabc21c9b6a9.png[/img]

[b]NOTE:[/b] [i]Just keep in mind that as we build the game and test and iterate on it, things WILL definitely change.
[/i]

If you squint, you’ll see the basic framework of the game in the upper left. An initial start screen gives you access to a menu with these choices, currently: story mode, playlist, how to play, multiplayer and options.

[i]Let’s focus on Story Mode for now.[/i]

Choosing Story Mode gives you access to three Save Slots to choose from. If you pick one and start a new game, you’ll find yourself on an isometric map of the city of Demashq and its immediate outskirts. This is your world map of sorts. The first location accessible will be Samar’s (your) home. This will be your hub: where you decorate your room, change your outfits, tweak your settings, chat with your friends on your personal computer (narrative device right there!), and change your spell loadout before going out for the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/3539dd4169a0bb3564525418a4d88ef5395f4b50.gif[/img]
 
Typically, Spirit Swap’s story plays in “runs” which in game translate as days. Don’t worry, there’s no real in-game calendar or limit on the time you have to complete aspects of the story, this is just meant to mark the rhythm of  the game and punctuate its loop. Additionally, story progress is persistent and doesn’t reset every new day/”run”.

A day always starts in your room: let’s say you pick an outfit and then a notification on your computer prompts you to check your messages. Talking to a character on your computer will sometimes allow you to “summon” them out that day. What does that mean? Every time you go out, there will be about three active locations on your map. An active location shows you that a character is present there currently. You can visit any location you like, but if no one is present there won’t be anything to do. IF someone is there, you’ll be able to either advance the overall story and “swap battle” them in 2P Versus OR advance their character specific arc and further your relationship with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a931995877a075d99548c3473db550ca694eb674.gif[/img]

Theoretically, you could just keep battling the same three characters and not realize you've run out of things to do...You could even accrue way too many rewards, room items or spells in one go, and it could get overwhelming to learn everything as you go if you don't decide to stop and return to your room hub where you can use them!

So, we're testing out an "event flag system", where every time you trip three of those flags (this could be three significant story interactions, or three items received, or a new spell), the game will let you know the day is over and the events on your map will disappear, prompting you to go home and check your spoils, relax, reset and go back out the next day. 

Again, a day ending doesn't lock you out of any events and none of them are time-gated in any way: it's just a way to keep you engaged in what the game throws at you without getting too overwhelmed.

The game’s minimum path to completion, or “Golden Path” involves talking to each character once and winning 9 total VS battles against each one. However, this is merely the tip of the iceberg if you’re here to date, explore and figure out the mysteries of your town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/e7eeb53fe56122b09d3a35f1a22eb9018f27b68c.gif[/img]
 
You can choose to deviate from the Golden Path at any moment and dedicate your time to getting to know one, two or every character - as long as you’ve met and battled them for the first time already.

The narrative remains linear, but the amount of side stories and content you can unlock and a ~Secret “True” Ending~ you can reach should keep you occupied for hours. Sometimes you hit a wall in your relationship with a character and you have to seek the help of other friends to figure things out, but getting to know one character better will never lock you out of romancing or befriending the others no matter how close you get. That will be interesting to write for!

We don’t want to talk too much about the ~Secret Ending~ because we want that to be a nice surprise for when the game ships… but in the right bottom corner of the image above you can see a hint to what it’ll revolve around… the concert date.

That’s all for how the game will work in terms of narrative progression! We’d love to hear your thoughts.

[h2]Game Devs of Color Expo[/h2]

The BEST game convention is coming soon, and we’re proud to say Spirit Swap is going to be a part of the showcase! Game Devs of Color Expo 2021 is happening September 23-27th, and not only will you be able to learn about the industry: you’ll be able to play some fantastic demos (including Spirit Swap)!
Learn all about what you can expect (and pick up tickets) at https://www.gamedevsofcolorexpo.com/.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/f80f459ac3ca471e69ceeed1d0f30bdf38249fc3.gif[/img]
 
[h2]Talk soon![/h2]

There are LOTS of events on the horizon (in addition to GDoC!) where you’ll see our team talking about Spirit Swap and game dev in general! 

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/softnotweak]Twitter [/url]for all the latest updates, wishlist our game if you haven't yet, and we’ll see you soon.

Until next time!

Love, The Spirit Swap Team
